name: Lamentations
lede: The twenty-fifth book of the Bible, in full: five laments over Jerusalem fallen — the city sitting solitary as a widow, her gates sunk into the ground, the elders silent in the dust — and in the midst of them, his compassions fail not, they are new every morning, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: How Doth the City Sit Solitary
books.blurb: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! She is become as a widow; she weepeth sore in the night; the ways of Zion do mourn; is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by?; the Lord hath covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger; her gates are sunk into the ground; the elders sit upon the ground and keep silence; thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

books.name: His Compassions Fail Not
books.blurb: I am the man that hath seen affliction; he hath made me to dwell in dark places; yet this I recall to my mind: his compassions fail not, they are new every morning, great is thy faithfulness; how is the gold become dim!; the crown is fallen from our head; the foxes walk upon the mountain of Zion; turn thou us unto thee, O Jehovah, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
